<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ecclesiastes 8:14">Targ. Koh. VIII, 14</cite>; a. e.—Part. act. a. pass. <he>גָּבֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Hosea 8:6">Targ. Hos. VIII, 6</cite> (some ed. incorr. <cite ref="C00104"><he>גַּבֵּי</he></cite>, v. Rashi a. l.).—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 12b:18">B. Mets. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>ניהו דלא גָבֵי … מִגְבָא גָבֵי</he> though it cannot be collected from mortgaged, it may be collected from unencumbered property.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 1:5:6">Y. Gitt. I, end, 43ᵈ</cite> <he>נחתון מִיגְבֵי וכ׳</he> they went down (to Babylonia) to collect debts there for friends; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 3:4:7">Y. Kidd. III, 64ᵃ</cite> <he>לגביה</he> (read <he>למִיגְבֵי</he>); cmp.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 17b:4">B. Mets. 17ᵇ</cite> <cite ref="M00108"><he>גַּבְיָא</he></cite> she has a right to collect (seize); a. fr.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Amos 4:5">Targ. Am. IV, 5</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Hosea 8:13">Targ. Hos. VIII, 13</cite> (some ed. <he>מְגַבַּן</he> Part. pass. Pa.).—
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ecclesiastes 11:4">Targ. Koh. XI, 4</cite> <he>לא מגבי אגר</he> makes not (people) derive any gain.—
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 98b">B. Kam. 98ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Ketubot 86a:4">Keth. 86ᵃ</cite> <he>מַגְבֵּי ביה</he> makes him pay.
<cite ref="Ketubot 86a:5">Ib.</cite> <he>א׳ ביה כי וכ׳</he> made him pay the full amount, v. <cite ref="K01300"><he>כָּשׁוֹרָא</he></cite>.
